blocks.original_text:
Ankita wapas uske paas aa kar khadi ho gayi. Ab uske andar ek alag si feeling chal rahi thi. Pehle kabhi usne kisi ke saamne itna casually apna body show nahi kiya tha. Aaj Chirag ke saamne usse excitement ho rahi thi — thoda sa tease karne ka mann bhi. Yeh feeling uske liye nayi thi.  
Ankita (halki si muskaan ke saath): “Uhhhh Chotu… jaise hamesha, kuch bhool gaye na?”  
Chirag ka chehra change hua.  
Chirag: “Oh yes… ice-creams. Freezer mein chhod aaya tha shop pe. Dus minute didi… abhi laata hoon.”
blocks.text:
Ankita ne dheere se poocha, “Chotuuu… kya dekh rahe ho?”
Chirag ekdum chaunk gaya. “Kuch nahi didi! Bas dekh raha tha aapko shelf se samaan rakhte hue… kahin gir na jao.”
Ankita muskurayi. “Awww… mera Chotu babu meri itni fikr karta hai?”
Chirag ne awkward si smile di aur nazar phir packets par tikane ki koshish ki.
Ankita ne thoda aur tease kiya. “Mujhe toh laga tum mere pet ko dekh rahe the.”
“Nahi didi… aisa kuch nahi,” Chirag ne jaldi se kaha.
Ankita hansi rok kar palat gayi. Usse ab samajh aa gaya tha ki Chirag ki nazar kahan ruki thi. Tuesday ko usne uski reaction jaanchne ki koshish ki thi; aaj ka shelf wala movement shuru mein bas kaam tha. Lekin Chirag ke chaunkne aur jhijhakne se uski curiosity aur badh gayi. Woh khud bhi abhi nahi samajh paa rahi thi ki is chhoti si teasing mein use itni dilchaspi kyun ho rahi hai. Woh wapas Chirag ke paas aa khadi hui jab woh packets arrange kar raha tha.

Chirag ka chehra badla. “Oh yes… ice-creams! Shop ke freezer mein chhod aaya tha. Dus minute, didi… abhi laata hoon.”
Woh uthkar jaldi se bahar nikal gaya.

blocks.original_text:
Raste bhar Chirag ka dimaag ek hi jagah ghoom raha tha.  
*Didi aaj alag kyun lag rahi hain? Main paagal hoon… uska pet kyun dekh liya? Teen din pehle Tuesday ko bhi… jab documents check kar rahe the, photos mein… uske… itne cream colour ke… itne white…*  
Usne sir hilaya, soch ko hatane ki koshish ki.  
*Main aisa soch nahi sakta. Didi mujhpe comfortable feel karti hain. Main usko spoil nahi karunga.*

blocks.original_text:
Woh daudta raha, lekin soch uske peeche-peeche chalti rahi.  
Ghar mein Ankita akeli thi. Uske andar excitement thi, aur thoda darr bhi. Agla kya hoga, yeh usse nahi pata tha. Tuesday ki baatein abhi bhi dimaag mein thi — woh conscious choices, woh testing, woh unresolved feeling. Aaj subah kuch naya shuru ho raha tha, aur woh usse rok nahi pa rahi thi.
